definitions.explanation: A small basket or bin for paper scraps and other rubbish, kept indoors by a desk. Often written くずかご or くず{籠|かご}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{屑籠|くずかご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.english: To throw paper into the wastebasket.
I put a wastebasket beside the desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書|か}き{損|そん}じた→書き損じる：18587_kakisonjiru⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丸|まる}めて→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧{屑籠|くずかご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{放|ほう}り{込|こ}んだ→放り込む：06852_hourikomu⟧。
examples.english: I crumpled up the botched letter and tossed it into the wastebasket.

notes:
In everyday speech, ごみ{箱|ばこ} is far more common; {屑籠|くずかご} sounds slightly old-fashioned and usually means a small one for paper.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屑籠|くずかご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to throw in the wastebasket
- {屑籠|くずかご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: the wastebasket fills up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ごみ{箱|ばこ}: trash can, rubbish bin (the everyday word)
- ⟦{屑|くず}→屑：03883_kuzu⟧: scraps, waste
